config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-chat"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
name: anthropic_to_chat_early_invalid_stream
